cause_quote: The doctor added the Chromium executable check as `status: status.detectError ? "fail" : status.detectedExecutablePath ? "pass" : "warn"` and the idle summary "Browser is launchable but not running", passing on executable presence alone.
user_saw: On Linux, browser doctor reported a managed Chromium as healthy and launchable even though it exited 127 on a missing shared library, so the real cause stayed hidden.
summary: The browser doctor route now runs a bounded `--version` probe of a local Linux Chromium executable and reports the loader error as a failed executable check, and the idle text no longer says 'launchable'.
reasoning: The doctor feature (feat(browser): expose doctor diagnostics to agents, pre-graft, read via gh api) introduced the executable check that passes whenever an executable path is detected and the 'launchable' wording; no later commit changed that logic, so the misleading health report shipped with the feature. It is borderline with a diagnostic enhancement, hence medium confidence; the commit subject has no PR number.
